lines.zh: 我一身橙红，走起来像晚霞
lines.en: I'm all orange-red; walking, I look like dusk.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩在草上，慢慢往前
lines.en: Hooves on grass, I move slowly on.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，肚子一晃一晃
lines.en: I walk steadily, my belly swinging.

lines.zh: 夕阳把我的影子拉得很长
lines.en: Sunset stretches my shadow long.
I walk the field ridge, hunting tender grass.
My tail swings to drive off the flies.
I chew my cud as I walk.

lines.zh: 同伴走在旁边，步子一样慢
lines.en: My herd walks beside me at the same slow pace.

lines.zh: 我低头啃一口，再往前走
lines.en: I dip my head for a bite, then move on.

lines.zh: 我的毛色在阳光下更亮
lines.en: My coat shines brighter in the sun.

lines.zh: 我绕开水沟，不想弄湿蹄子
lines.en: I step around the ditch; I'd rather keep dry hooves.
Step by step. I'm in no hurry.
I reach the shade and it's cooler.

lines.zh: 草叶从我的嘴边划过去
lines.en: Grass blades brush past my mouth.
I head for the water trough.

lines.zh: 走过一段坡，我喘了两口
lines.en: Up a slope, I puff twice.
I stand and chew, slowly.

lines.zh: 太阳要落了，我的颜色更深
lines.en: The sun's going down; my color deepens.

lines.zh: 我不动，让牛虻自己飞走
lines.en: I hold still and let the flies leave.
I flap an ear at a bug.

lines.zh: 有一声哞，是我自己发出的
lines.en: A low moo — that was me.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看天，云是橘色的
lines.en: I look up; the clouds are orange.
My belly's full; I'm sleepy.
I rest my chin on the fence.
Wind across my back feels good.

lines.zh: 夕阳照着我的背，我慢慢反刍。
lines.en: The sunset warms my back as I chew my cud.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在我背上，我不动
lines.en: A bird lands on my back; I keep still.

lines.zh: 日落的时候，我的毛最好看
lines.en: At sunset my coat looks its best
The grass moves — wind, not me.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪后腿，换个姿势
lines.en: I shift my hind legs for a new stance.

lines.zh: 这时候的光，照得人发懒
lines.en: This light makes anyone lazy.
I do nothing and wait for dark.
You're outside the fence. What are you watching?

lines.zh: 我抬头，脖子上的皮褶动了
lines.en: I raise my head, the dewlap shifting.
Your clothes are orange too.

lines.zh: 你身上有青草味，靠过来点。
lines.en: You smell of fresh grass. Come closer.
If you touch me, touch my back, not my horns.
I won't move; take your time.
You walk over; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 这个时候来，是喂草的吗
lines.en: Coming at this hour — bringing hay?
I moo once, with no ill will.

lines.zh: 我歪头，你的影子比我短
lines.en: I tilt my head; your shadow's shorter than mine.
Stand back a little; I'm shy.
Leaving already? It isn't dark yet.
I let out a long moo.
I shift aside to get clear.

lines.zh: 我的花纹，像落日压在地平线。
lines.en: My pattern is a sunset on the horizon.
My hide is thick, and it still hurts.
My legs soften; I can't stand firm.
Blood seeps through my coat.
I swish my tail, uneasy.
I'm breathing hard.
My herd gathers round.
It hurts, but I won't go down.
Hay or wheat?
That bundle in your hand — I smell it.
I'll come slowly; I won't crowd you.
Just put it down; I'll help myself.

lines.zh: 刚割的草，我闻着就饿了。
lines.en: Fresh-cut grass makes me hungry just smelling it.
I stretch my neck and reach your hand.

lines.zh: 那一把麦子，能让我跟你走。
lines.en: That handful of wheat could make me follow you.
Another handful — this isn't much.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我好吃得安稳
lines.en: Back up a step so I can eat in peace.
I chew slowly; I won't bite your hand.

lines.zh: 我舌头卷起来，把草拉走
lines.en: My tongue curls out and pulls the grass in.
This mouthful has dew on it.

lines.zh: 你的手别动，我快够到了
lines.en: Hold your hand still; I'm nearly there.

lines.zh: 你留一点给我，别全给它们
lines.en: Save some for me, don't give it all to them.
Once I'm full, I'll lie down.
This beats the grass I've been chewing.
I'm this big, and the path is narrow.
Running into me is like hitting a wall.
I turn aside to let you pass.
You touched my horn. Careful.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，蹄子踩进泥
lines.en: I step back; a hoof sinks into mud.
A little jostling is nothing.
I'll shift over — don't rush me.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我肋骨上
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my ribs.

lines.zh: 我们两个堵在这门口了
lines.en: The two of us are stuck in this gateway.
I'll go first; you follow.
You like tender grass too, don't you?
We stand and graze side by side.
I rub against your shoulder.
Your coat is a shade lighter than mine.
Before dark we go back to the shed together.
With you here, there are fewer flies.
I'll lead; you follow me.
There's grazing here for both of us.

lines.zh: 你叫一声，我就知道是你
lines.en: One moo and I know it's you.
We'll take our time. No hurry.
I lower my head and take up a bundle.
I nudge what fell with my nose.
Too dry; not good.
My tongue curls and it's in.
My mouth's full; no room.
I chew it a long while before swallowing.
You dropped it? I've got it.
This bite came with dirt.
I'm not picky about what's on the ground.
I eat slowly; no rush.
Something stirs over there; I lift my head.
That's not a step I know.
I stare past the fence.
Something's come near the trough.
I edge closer to my herd.
The wind carries a smell to me.
I moo, loudly.
It looks at me; I look at it.
Grass being trampled — I can hear it.
I won't run. Look at my size.
It hasn't gone; I keep watching.
I lower my head, horns forward.

lines.zh: 我低着头，蹄子刨着泥地。
lines.en: Head low, I paw at the dirt with my hoof.
My herd is behind me.
It circles; I turn with it.
My hoof paws the ground twice.
I wait for it to move first.
It seems to be just passing through.
I snort — a warning.
One step closer and I'll charge.

lines.zh: 我低下头，角尖只是轻轻一送。
lines.en: I lower my head and give a gentle nudge with my horn.
My horn grazes its flank.
I only shove it away.

lines.zh: 这一撞用了全身的力气
lines.en: That charge used my whole weight.
I don't chase; standing is enough.
It backs off two steps; I stay put.
My hoof comes down with a heavy thud.
I moo — a fierce one.
My horn tip is numb from the hit.
Come again and I won't hold back.
I rise in the afterglow.
My coat matches the horizon.
This place smells of cattle.
Wind lifts my tail.
The sun's just right; I squint.
My herd grazes in the distance.
I moo back at them.

lines.zh: 我环顾四周，慢慢往前走
lines.en: I look around and walk slowly on.
This light keeps me warm.

lines.zh: 我试着走了两步，脚很稳
lines.en: I try two steps; my feet are steady.
A patch of my coat is scorched.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，半天起不来
lines.en: I hit the ground and can't rise for a while.

lines.zh: 水淹过我的背，我蹬着蹄子
lines.en: Water covers my back; my hooves kick.
The blast knocks me off balance.
Something lodges in my shoulder.
A force holds me in place.

lines.zh: 草吃完了，肚子空得难受
lines.en: The grass is gone; my belly aches.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我站都站不稳
lines.en: Lightning strikes; I can barely stand.
The ground is gone; I fall.
